ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The top histogram is labeled non-breeding season. In it, helper males and breeding males both have low mean testosterone levels, about 10. The bottom histogram is labeled breeding season. In it, helper males remain low at about 10, while breeding males rise much higher, about 50. Thus testosterone is not high in all males all the time; it increases mainly in breeding males during the breeding season. Reasoning: The text says helper males stay in the natal group and help raise younger siblings, while breeding males leave to establish territories. Higher testosterone during the breeding season would fit territorial and reproductive behavior in breeding males, while lower testosterone would fit helper males by reducing aggression and supporting caregiving behavior. Because the hormone pattern is matched to role and season in a way that may improve fitness, testosterone level in this population may be an example of an adaptation.

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有两个柱状图。上方的“Non-breeding season”柱状图显示，helper male 和 breeding male 的平均 testosterone/T 水平都大约是 10，二者没有明显差异。下方的“Breeding season”柱状图显示，helper male 的平均 T 水平仍大约是 10，而 breeding male 的平均 T 水平升高到大约 50，出现明显的角色差异。
推理：题干说明这些雄鸟有两种社会角色：留在出生群体中帮助抚育弟妹，或离开并建立新领地。图像显示 T 水平不是所有雄性固定不变的特征，而是随繁殖季节和社会/繁殖角色而变化。繁殖季节中建立领地、具有繁殖机会的雄性 T 水平显著升高，而帮助者保持较低水平，这种调节可能有利于繁殖竞争、领地行为或合作行为。因此，该种群中的 testosterone level 可以被看作一种适应性生理调节，即一种 adaptation。
